(±)-8- [(4-Amino-1-methylbutyl)amino]-2,6-dimethoxy-4-methyl-5- [(α,α,α-trifluoro-m-tolyl)oxy]quinoline; (RS)-N4-[2,6-Dimethoxy- 4-methyl-5-(3-trifluoromethylphenoxy)quinolin-8-yl]pentane- 1,4-diamine. Тафенохин C24H28F3N3O3 = 463.5. CAS — 106635-80-7. Profile Tafenoquine is an 8-aminoquinoline antimalarial. It acts as a tis- sue schizontocide and is under investigation as the succinate for the radical cure and prevention of relapse in vivax malaria. It may also have a role in the prophylaxis of falciparum malaria. ◊ References. 1. Walsh DS, et al.
